description: This file contains CMake functions and macros related to handling header-only library installation and configuration. It defines two main functions: HeaderOnlyInstallCMakeConfig for configuring target-specific CMake package files, and HeaderOnlyInstallPackageConfig for generating package configuration files like .pc for pkg-config. The script manages finding templates, validating targets, and setting up installation paths and dependencies.

methods.name: HeaderOnlyInstallCMakeConfig
methods.description: Configures and installs a header-only library's CMake configuration files, including versioning, target alias, and dependencies.

methods.name: HeaderOnlyInstallPackageConfig
methods.description: Generates and installs a pkg-config (.pc) file for a header-only library, including compiling options, include directories, and link libraries.
